notes.title: Disc Flight Path Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44645925/f04b0114bb103a01d0d8480598d9c2f02dfefc8f.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Improved aiming to reflect hyzer/anhyzer prediction
[*] Added animation blendspace to show disc angle more realistically
[*] Hyzer and anhyzer function more accurately
[*] General physics improvements for disc and baskets
[*] Removed Tap-in feature and replaced with "Gimme" score
[*] Throws with midrange, fairway, and drivers are no longer stand still throws
[*] Added player emote animations (on teepads - player activated coming soon!)
[*] Added pickup animations
[*] Disc hit sound and particle effect are now based on the surface hit
[*] Adjusted Cash and XP earned
[*] Added compass to HUD
[*] Improved basket and teepad markers
[*] Added marker to show/remind player to retrieve thrown discs
[*] Thrown discs are now removed from player inventory
[*] Recovered disc are now returned to player inventory
[*] Improved water hazards
[*] General upgrades to HUD
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Dec 28th
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Flight paths now interact with air more accurately
[*] Angle of disc trajectory now requires a more precise range
[*] Drag impacts disc through angular and linear dampening
[*] Player no longer receives decals such as puddles or paint
[*] Aiming is more accurate and has a predicted landing spot based off ideal throw power
[*] Disc collision with the landscape has been optimized
[*] Pause Menu now allows for restarting the current level
[*] Pause Menu now allows for quitting to the Main Menu or Desktop
[*] Additional controls not complete have been removed (i.e. switching disc hands, disabling HUD, etc.)
[*] Changing discs now updates on the HUD
[*] Removed 'Gimme Spot' which finished a hole adding a stroke assuming next shot would be made
[*] Improved basket catching/registering
[*] Corrected Fast Travel system to work more appropriately
[*] General optimization of disc and player
[*] Added basic tutorial to demonstrate throwing
[*] Improved throwing animation of backhand throw
[/list]
